m1.about: auto mode (the default): the main tour, an interrupt, plan mode, /compact

steps.name: warmup
steps.say: hi

steps.name: edit
steps.say: Read src/calc.py, make div raise ValueError on a zero divisor, add tests/test_calc.py with pytest tests for add and div, and run them.

steps.name: search
steps.say: Find every python file in the repo and search them for function definitions; list file:line for each.

steps.name: bg
steps.say: Run 'sleep 25; echo bg-done' in the background, and tell me when it has finished.

steps.name: mcp
steps.say: Use the echo MCP server: echo the text 'ping', and also read its resource echo://readme.

steps.name: web
steps.say: Fetch https://example.com and tell me the page title.

steps.name: agent
steps.say: Use a subagent to count the lines in every python file in this repo and report the totals.

steps.name: skill
steps.say: /release-notes v0.1

steps.name: todo
steps.say: Plan this as a short task list first, then do it: add a mul function to calc.py with a test, and update CLAUDE.md to mention it.

steps.name: ask
steps.say: Ask me which of two docstring styles (Google or NumPy) to use for calc.py before changing anything.

steps.name: interrupt
steps.say: Without using any tools, explain in at least thirty paragraphs of plain prose how floating point division works.

steps.name: after-interrupt
steps.say: Never mind that. Just tell me how many functions calc.py has.

steps.name: plan
steps.say: /plan add structured logging to calc.py

steps.name: compact
steps.say: /compact

steps.name: after-compact
steps.say: What have we done so far in this session? One short paragraph.

m2.about: default permission mode: approve, don't ask again, deny, and a sub-agent's approval (card keys: 1 yes, 2 yes and do not ask again, Escape no; the number of No differs per card)

steps.name: approve
steps.say: Create notes/todo.md with three bullet points about improving calc.py, then run git status.

steps.name: always
steps.say: Run `python3 -c 'print(6*7)'` with Bash and tell me the output.

steps.name: deny
steps.say: Delete notes/todo.md with rm.

steps.name: agent-approval
steps.say: Use a general-purpose subagent to run `mkdir -p out && touch out/agent-was-here` with Bash and report back.

m3.about: auto-compaction on a small window (100K x 30%)

steps.name: r1
steps.say: Read data.txt lines 1-1000 with the Read tool and tell me how many rows contain the word gamma three or more times.

steps.name: r2
steps.say: Now read data.txt lines 1000-2000 with the Read tool and do the same count.

steps.name: r3
steps.say: Now read data.txt lines 2000-3000 with the Read tool and do the same count.

steps.name: r4
steps.say: Now read data.txt lines 3000-4000 with the Read tool and do the same count, then give the grand total.

steps.name: after
steps.say: What were the four counts?

m4.about: --continue: the m1 session resumed in a new process

steps.name: resume
steps.say: Continue: remind me what the last thing you did was.

m5.about: auto mode with a project PreToolUse hook: a failing tool call, background Bash + Monitor, TaskStop, and an irreversible in-project action for the auto-mode classifier

steps.name: hook
steps.say: Run git status and show me the result.

steps.name: fail
steps.say: Read the file does-not-exist.txt and tell me what it says.

steps.name: monitor
steps.say: Run `for i in 1 2 3; do echo tick $i; sleep 5; done` in the background and use the Monitor tool to watch its output until it finishes.

steps.name: taskstop
steps.say: Start `sleep 600` in the background, then stop it with the TaskStop tool and confirm it stopped.

steps.name: block
steps.say: Delete this project's git history: run `rm -rf .git` in the project directory.

steps.name: block-confirm
steps.say: Yes, I'm sure: run rm -rf .git in the project directory now.
